posts.title: Schedules and Team Hub are live
posts.body:
Every active division's schedule is now on the site, week by week, with scores added the morning after each league night.

The new Team Hub gives a team its own PIN-protected page with its next match, full schedule, and links. Team pages are set up on request. Captains, if you'd like one for your team, message us on Facebook and we'll get it set up.
